_doc: Santé des mods. Everything the pane shows is set here; ~/.claude/sante-mod/sante.config.json (data_dir) is deep-merged on top, and userConfig `config` names another override file. Paths take ~ for the home folder.
_default_min_version: Minimum Claude Code for a mod with no min_version of its own: function-hook mods, panes and Svg need 2.1.287 (plugins/mods/overview).
_extra_dirs: Folders whose subfolders are mods (each with .claude-plugin/plugin.json): shown « non chargé » when not in CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS. The folder that holds this mod (its siblings) is added unless siblings is false.
_installed_plugins_file: Marketplace plugins: the file Claude Code keeps under ~/.claude/plugins (name and format not documented: non vérifié). Empty string to skip.

thresholds._cache_warn_mb: orange above this size on disk (per cache path); per mod: mods.<name>.cache_warn_mb
thresholds._health_error_hours: a health record's error counts as red while its lastRun is this recent

_cleanup_command: Shown (and copied with the button), never run: Julian or an agent runs it. {path} is the cache path.
_mods: Per mod (plugin.json name): caches (files or folders: size, newest change = last refresh), configs (user config files to validate), logs (error lines), error_fields ({file, field}: a list of errors inside an output file), stale_min (orange when the newest cache change is older), min_version, cache_warn_mb.

labels.summary: {word} · {active} mods actifs : {ok} OK, {warn} orange, {error} rouge · {off} non chargés · Claude Code {engine}
labels.first_scan: Premier examen des mods en cours…
labels.no_health: pas de fiche santé (convention mods-health non adoptée)
notes: Lecture seule : rien n'est bloqué, réécrit ni ajouté au prompt ; rien n'est supprimé (les commandes de nettoyage sont seulement affichées).
Chargé = au moins une commande du mod dans cette session ($.command.list). Version de Claude Code : $.session.version().
CPU et durées : fiches ~/.claude/mods-health/<mod>.json écrites par les mods qui suivent la convention (voir mods/sante/README.md).
